verdict.rationale: Snyk is a SaaS security platform, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Jira and Slack partner integrations are chat or ticketing integrations and do not qualify. The Snyk Studio 'hooks-based approach' refers to coding-agent hooks in development environments, not webhook event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
